paragraphs: Yonatan be-Rabbi Yose: end of Maaserot. Ben Yose: Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 4:3:3 (cited here as 4:4) and Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 5:2:5 (cited here as 5:4). Rabbi Yonatan be-Rabbi Yose said it according to his teacher Rabbi Akiva’s position.
